prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interactive Control Demo Flow: Adds an interactive quick-command checklist on the final screen teaching users how to summon, interact with, and hide their desktop pet. (why: Addresses top support post-onboarding confusion (3 emails) where users don't know how to control or hide their pet after setup.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign In After Adoption Flow: Moves account sign-in after pet adoption certificate creation so users experience pet creation before registering. (why: Capitalizes on adoption completion momentum and reduces initial friction where drop-off occurs early.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesigns the intro story screen into a split layout showcasing animated desktop pet previews side-by-side with benefit callouts. (why: Initial path selection has a 76.2% conversion rate; stronger visual engagement on story increases onboarding momentum.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Pet Trait Selection Screen: Inserts a new pet personality screen before adoption certificate generation allowing users to pick companion behavioral traits. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.6%; adding personalized trait selection increases emotional ownership.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Audio Visualizer: Adds an interactive audio feedback button and progress status bar while waiting for pet desktop assets to render. (why: Median waiting screen time is 201s (mean 2336s), creating drop-off without clear progress indicators.)
5: [finish, copy] Final Screen Control Shortcuts Card: Updates the final welcome screen body copy with clear desktop control shortcuts and right-click interaction instructions. (why: Addresses post-onboarding user feedback (3 emails) regarding difficulty finding control and hide commands.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync Safeguard Notification Banner: Adds a notification hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that existing pets and progress will be securely linked to their account. (why: 8 support emails (largest theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
7: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Adoption Certificate Screen Redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a full-bleed celebratory card featuring a playful sound preview component. (why: Improves step conversion on adoption (currently 69.6%) by turning pet creation confirmation into a highly rewarding milestone.)
